claims.text: Phexxi (lactic acid, citric acid, K bitartrate gel): on-demand contraception
claims.quote: PHEXXI is indicated for the prevention of pregnancy in females of reproductive potential for use as an on-demand method of contraception.
claims.locator: PHEXXI (lactic acid, citric acid, and potassium bitartrate) vaginal gel prescribing information

claims.text: One applicator (5 g) vaginally just b4 or up to one hr b4 each act
claims.quote: Administer one pre-filled applicator of PHEXXI (5 grams) vaginally immediately before or up to one hour before each act of vaginal intercourse.
claims.locator: PHEXXI (lactic acid, citric acid, and potassium bitartrate) vaginal gel prescribing information

claims.text: N-9 spermicides may disrupt genital or rectal epithelium; assoc w ↑HIV risk
claims.quote: Spermicides containing nonoxynol-9 (N-9) might disrupt genital or rectal epithelium and have been associated with an increased risk for HIV infection.
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2021;70(4):1-187 (PMC8344968)

claims.text: N-9 alone or w a condom ⍉recommended for STI or HIV prev
claims.quote: N-9 alone or in a condom is not recommended for STI and HIV prevention
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2021;70(4):1-187 (PMC8344968)
